remaining.summary: Production end-to-end verification used Chrome. The face detector missed a wider fixture where pose detection succeeded. DBS-TIGER CPU time varies by device.

resolution.summary: Deployed browser-only MediaPipe face and pose framing and DBS-TIGER speech separation to pocut.vxu.me. Production Chrome QA applied the portrait crop and persisted two aligned local stereo stems across reload. The exported QA archive contains finite stereo 48 kHz PCM, matching stem lengths, and the test tones were approximately 31 dB stronger in background than speech. Static model and WASM assets are pinned, and both legacy inference routes return 404 on the hosted site.
